strings.resourceHeadingDescription: Alert Hub is an open source web project developed in collaboration with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) as a part of the University College London (UCL) Industry Exchange Network (IXN). You can find all the source code and instructions under the following repositories.
strings.faqWhoIsTheAudience: Who is the audience of the IFRC AlertHub?
strings.ifrcSubscriptionDescription: To subscribe to alerts on the IFRC AlertHub platform, log in to your account and navigate to the My Subscriptions section located in the top-left corner of the site. Choose the topics or categories that interest you, such as specific countries, hazards, or urgency levels. Click the Subscribe button, set your preferred alert frequency (e.g., daily or weekly), and save your preferences. Once subscribed, you’ll receive updates tailored to your selections. You can create multiple subscriptions to cover different interests. To modify or cancel your subscriptions, simply return to the My Subscriptions section.
